sources.note: Bounded 2021 Crop Production Department manual slices cover irrigation design for northern and Central Highlands conditions, terrain-aware orchard setup, and harvest/packing. Chemical pest-control appendices are excluded.

Bounded VAAS and National Agricultural Extension Center winter-tomato slice for nursery, soil preparation, planting and establishment in northern production conditions. Fertilizer and pesticide sections are excluded.

The source explicitly provides separate northern safe-vegetable nutrition schedules for six named crops. Batch 10 slices each crop at section markers so per-hectare rates cannot be attributed across crops; the general vegetables scope remains baseline evidence for biologically similar vegetables.

Same-species Colocasia/Leucocasia gigantea baseline for soil, light, container and wind exposure; not conflated with C. esculenta and not treated as a Vietnamese food-production protocol.
The HTML bok-choy section is bounded between neighboring crops; Central Oregon calendar dates require local adaptation.

Vietnamese northern-region Star Ol zucchini protocol split into bounded establishment, nutrition, care, cultural-IPM and harvest slices. Legacy pesticide names and chemical recommendations are excluded.

Regional Nam Dan, Nghe An field case for culinary lemongrass on water-limited upland rice soil and first-harvest timing; explicitly not generalized as a national production protocol or conflated with Java citronella grass.

Vietnamese Panama-disease diagnosis and integrated management guidance associated with the Binh Phuoc extension service. The seed-treatment chemical span and the entire chemical-control section are excluded.
Current Vietnamese replacement protocol for cassava mosaic disease, split into diagnosis/transmission, non-chemical prevention and age-based removal slices. The chemical-control section is excluded.
Only the fruit-vegetable HTX handling slice for cucumber, okra and bitter melon is retained. Earlier chlorine, ozone and chemical-treatment content is excluded by markers and forbidden-term checks.
Hòa Vang, Da Nang local protocol split into establishment/care and harvest slices. The pest-control section and all product names are excluded.
Red River Delta carrot establishment, care and harvest slices. The broad pesticide sentence is excluded by section boundary and forbidden-term checks.
Florida planting and harvest tables provide a second crop-specific extension source. The pesticide-product table is excluded, and dates, spacing and yields require local Vietnamese validation.
A bounded Florida greenhouse and hydroponic herb-trial slice is used only as crop-specific production evidence; it is not a Vietnamese field protocol.
Scientific names keep cilantro/coriander distinct from parsley and culantro. Florida warm/cool-season labels require local Vietnamese validation.
Florida vegetable-amaranth propagation, water and harvest slices; fertilizer, pest/disease and medical-use sections are excluded.
Bok choy is identified as Brassica rapa subsp. chinensis and split into establishment and harvest slices. Fertilizer rates and the chemical pest-control section are excluded.
Bottle-gourd/long-squash direct seeding, seedlings, soil, irrigation and vine training only; the fertilizer span is excluded.
Luffa climate, soil-water, transplanting, trellis and immature-harvest guidance; fertilizer rates and pest content are excluded.
Yardlong-bean soil, climate, planting, trellis and immature-pod harvest slices; fertilizer and pest-control content are excluded.
The bounded Asian-legume paragraph covers edamame/soybean, winged bean and yardlong bean photoperiod, seed treatment, irrigation and support. All pesticide tables are excluded.
Peer-reviewed Utah Extension slices for globe-artichoke soil, plants, water and bud maturity. Fertilizer and pest sections are excluded, and Utah dates require Vietnamese adaptation.
Peer-reviewed Utah Extension guidance identifies true garlic, planting material, water, maturity, curing and storage. Fertilizer and pest sections are excluded.
UF/IFAS identifies Eryngium foetidum distinctly from cilantro and covers shade, moist soil, seed germination and selective leaf harvest.
NC State species-specific baseline for Houttuynia cordata moisture, shade, rhizome spread and containment; it is not presented as a Vietnamese commercial protocol.
UF/IFAS identifies Pachyrhizus erosus, warm-season root development and the food-safety distinction that only roots are edible.
Crop-specific UF/IFAS environmental tables for dragonfruit and mango temperature, wind, flooding, salinity and drought; Florida thresholds require local validation.
UF/IFAS pineapple climate-stress and vegetative-propagation slices. Fertilizer and pest-management sections are excluded and Florida values require adaptation.
Explicitly limited to microgreen production for shiso/perilla, purslane and watercress; it is not evidence for mature-crop management.
The bounded UF/IFAS Asian-vegetable table is used strictly for crop identity and alias disambiguation, not as a detailed production protocol.
ICAR-IISR evidence for black-pepper scientific cultivation, planting material, nursery techniques and varietal diversity; no chemical dose is retained.
UF/IFAS identifies Tong Hao/Glebionis coronaria/Tan O and covers soil, temperature, sowing and one-time versus repeated harvest. Fertilizer text is excluded.
A bounded UC Davis Horticulture Innovation Lab table identifies edible shoots/leaves and cutting or division propagation for Sauropus androgynus and Piper sarmentosum.
University of Miami crop card for Sauropus androgynus planting/harvest season and rapidly growing tender tips; Miami seasonality is not generalized to Vietnam.
NC State identifies Centella asiatica distinctly from other pennyworts and covers propagation, moist soil, edible leaves and heavy-metal uptake risk.
Bounded Purdue Extension table rows identify Vigna radiata, Benincasa hispida and Nelumbo nucifera with establishment and maturity/harvest context; US dates require local adaptation.
Clemson Extension slices cover Arachis hypogaea pegging, establishment, soil, maturity indicators, digging, curing and mold avoidance. Fertilizer and pesticide sections are excluded.
ICAR-IIPR bounded evidence for short-duration, disease-resistant mungbean varieties, regional adaptation and relative maturity. The subsequent field section mentioning insecticides is excluded.
University of Guam Extension crop chart distinguishes D. esculenta, D. alata and D. rotundata with local selections and planting windows; Guam dates require local adaptation.
Bounded Codex commodity-classification rows identify taro stems/Colocasia esculenta and zuiki/Colocasia gigantea. It is not used as cultivation or pesticide-dose guidance.

National Citrus Research and Development Center guidance for pre-plant soil rehabilitation, raised planting, root and canopy management, non-herbicide weed control and organic soil improvement. Quantified fertilizer examples and later foliar-product advice are excluded.

Bounded 2023 National Agricultural Extension Center VietGAP slices for Thai and Taiwan mango identity, grafted-seedling quality, planting season and age-specific nutrition in the northern midlands and mountains. Flower-induction chemicals and pesticide sections are excluded; fertilizer quantities retain their narrow crop, age and region scope.

WASI principles for balanced black-pepper nutrition by growth stage, nutrient removal and soil fertility in Vietnamese production. The downstream practice diagram and any inferred field dose are excluded.

FAO-commissioned Agro Eco manual slice for organic Sugarloaf pineapple in Ghana: green manure, pineapple residues, compost, organic matter and acidic-soil principles. Ghana timing and quantities are not generalized to Vietnam.
